Global state gains a `counters` field and `TrackerLike` gains `keyScope`, `currentView()`, `disable()` and `queuedCount()`. This is so getNexusStats() and the kill switch work across the three separate bundles. `xhrPatch` is stored as `{proto, original, patched}` instead of `{open, send, setRequestHeader}`, because restoring the prototype only 'if still ours' needs both the originals and our wrappers.

isSameOrigin and isExcluded are defined in header-source.ts and re-exported from fetch-patch.ts, which avoids a header-source <-> fetch-patch import cycle. `activeHeaderSource()` picks the newest source that is still allowed (not killed, header_propagation not disabled), not just the newest.

New file core/batch-sender.ts (BatchSender): the in-page single-flight sender with back-off and persist-once. Retry replays go through it with `sendOnce()`, so the one-keepalive-in-flight rule also covers replays.
parseRemoteConfig lives in config-cache.ts and is re-exported from remote-config.ts. This keeps the early bundle free of remote-config code. The cache also uses `cachedBlocksPropagation()`.

The replay queue drains only after the startup config refresh settles, so a kill code purges the queue before anything is replayed. Persisted entries are removed (`forget`) when an in-page retry later succeeds, which avoids replaying a batch that was already delivered.

A 200 config with `enabled: false` (reserved by the server) is treated as a kill. A cached disable found at start does not rewrite the cache, so the 15-minute recheck still happens. A 401/403 with an unknown code is classified as 'drop'.
nextRouteTemplate: a segment that fails decodeURIComponent is compared raw instead of aborting. An empty params object (static route) returns the pathname as its template.
test-harness.ts now stubs global fetch with URL routing (202 for ingest, a configurable config response) and makes flushByTimer async, because live sends now use async fetch, one at a time.

SdkHealthRow has one column the spec does not list: `latest_release_at` (`max(occurred_at) FILTER (WHERE release IS NOT NULL)`). releaseStatusOf needs it to pick the newest `latest_release` across several SDK rows of one source, which the DTO contract ('release of the newest event that had one') requires.
